plan.title: Convert the policy-set write path to native TypeScript (Phase 1)

narratives.Description: The policy-set write path is still served by a loadPythonScriptHandler route in packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts (~line 501) that shells into scripts/policy_set.py, while the policy read path is already native TypeScript. This story ports the policy write path to TypeScript so editing a typed policy field no longer requires Python.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Implement a native TypeScript policy-set write handler that mirrors scripts/policy_set.py, including the audit row written to meta/policy-changes.log.
- Replace the dispatch.ts policy-set route at ~line 501 with the native handler and add a test asserting a write updates the typed field and appends the audit row.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator setting a typed policy field, I want the write path in TypeScript, so that policy edits and their audit log work without a Python dependency.

items.title: Given dispatch.ts, when policy-set is dispatched, then it routes to a native TypeScript handler with no loadPythonScriptHandler call.

narrative.Acceptance: Given dispatch.ts, when policy-set is dispatched, then it routes to a native TypeScript handler with no loadPythonScriptHandler call.

items.title: Given the TypeScript policy-set handler, when a typed field is written, then the field updates and an audit row is appended to meta/policy-changes.log.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the TypeScript policy-set handler, when a typed field is written, then the field updates and an audit row is appended to meta/policy-changes.log.
